name: quest-completer
author: aamiaa (skrip asli, GPL-3.0) — diport ke plugin
description: Menjalankan skrip Complete Recent Discord Quest (WATCH_VIDEO, PLAY_ON_DESKTOP, STREAM_ON_DESKTOP, PLAY_ACTIVITY) langsung dari injector, tanpa paste ke DevTools console. Otomasi quest melanggar ToS Discord dan berisiko flag/suspend akun.
